about_the_game:
What you have to do is simple: open the box, which is locked with 3~8 digits, with your hands! Solving riddles? Hints? No such thing. Just try them all and you'll open them.

Video Posting, Distribution, and Monetization

This game may be freely used in video postings and live distribution.

There are no restrictions on monetization or donations!

If you want to ask us for permission directly, please feel free to contact us via X (formerly Twitter) or email.

・About the operation

Click the button above the number to increase the number.

Clicking the button below the number decreases the number.

(You can select a digit with the ←/→ keys and change the number with the ↑/↓ keys.)

(You can also use the number keys to change the number of the currently selected digit.)

Clicking on a treasure chest will attempt to open it.

If the number is right, the treasure chest is opened and the game is cleared.

You will receive many rewards for clearing the game!

(You can also use the Space/Enter key to open the chest.)

・About Skill

Although there are no hints, “coins” and “gems” sometimes fall in the game.

Coins and gems can be consumed for a slightly more efficient matching of numbers.

Coins are always consumed, but the type of gems consumed changes with each skill.

Of course, you don't have to use any of these, just try them all and they will open!

・About the difficulty level

The difficulty level can be set freely between 3~8 digits.

You can save your game by each digit, so you can interrupt the game and start with another digit.

It is not possible to create multiple save data with the same number of digits.

The more digits you have, the bigger the reward for clearing the game.

(+10 times the average points earned for each digit)

If you clear the game without using any skills, the reward for clearing that digit will be permanently increased by 1.2 times.
